approvers: Site manager and glazing/aluminium subcontractor; developer if cost is passed on
reason: I already spend about 12 euro a m2 all-in with my own labour and the aluminium arrives with factory film. You want about 19 a m2, which is more than I pay now, to protect against damage I mostly handle already. A 2,500 euro cap on a block with hundreds of windows does not make me feel covered.
objection: It costs more than what my crew does today, the frames already come with film, and I would be your first Maltese reference job with no local track record.
instead: Keep using factory film plus film or board and tape applied by my own crew, and push glazing damage back to the aluminium subcontractor.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or below 12 euro a m2 all-in, plus a finished Maltese block where the coating peeled off cleanly and damage claims dropped.
